title: Combining the Dispute Response Fee Multipliers by Account Age, Northloop Payments
content:
**Rule.** The standing fee multiplier, the store fee multiplier and the evidence timing multiplier of a Northloop Payments dispute response fee combine into one combined fee multiplier as follows: when the payments account was opened at least 730 calendar days before the return date, the three are multiplied together; when it was opened fewer than 365 calendar days before, only the largest of the three applies; otherwise only the smallest of the three applies. The dispute response fee is the base response fee times the combined fee multiplier, rounded to the cent.

The age is the number of calendar days from the opening date of the payments account to the return date.

## Combination by account age

| Calendar days from account opening to the return date | Combined fee multiplier |
|---|---|
| fewer than 365 | the largest of the three |
| 365 to 729 | the smallest of the three |
| 730 or more | the three multiplied together |

## Hypothetical worked example (base response fee 25.00 USD; multipliers standing 1.5, store 0.8, timing 0.5)

| Account age | Combined fee multiplier | Dispute response fee |
|---|---|---|
| 200 days | 1.5, the largest | 25.00 times 1.5, that is 37.50 USD |
| 500 days | 0.5, the smallest | 12.50 USD |
| 900 days | 1.5 times 0.8 times 0.5, that is 0.6 | 15.00 USD |

Boundaries: 364 days takes the largest, 365 the smallest, 729 the smallest and 730 the product.
